description: Open the Cruma desktop app on this machine, or bring it forward when it is already running, so the user can see the tunnels and settings set up here. Call it only when the user asks to see them. Never call it in CI or on a machine without a screen. `status` is `opened`, `focused` or `unavailable`; unavailable carries a `reason` (`no_gui_in_this_build`, `no_display`, `not_installed`, `launch_failed`) and an `install_hint`.
name: open_desktop_app
